# Read in data

```{r ReadData}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Function to construct file path for data loading
read_data <- function(file_name) {
  read.csv(here("Data", file_name))
}

# Load functional groupings data
functional_group <- read_data("species_functional.csv")

# Load camera survey data and preprocess
all_cam <- read_data("video_surveys.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize tide levels
    Tide = as.factor(case_when(
      Tide == "High" ~ "High Tide",
      Tide == "Low"  ~ "Low Tide"
    )),
    # Group substrates into broader categories
    substrate = as.factor(case_when(
      Substrate %in% c("turbinaria", "coral", "turf", "sand", "macroalgae") ~ "Benthos",
      Substrate == "plankton" ~ "Water Column"
    ))
  ) %>%
  # Merge with functional group data based on species codes
  mutate(code = Code) %>%
  left_join(functional_group, by = 'code') %>%
  # remove highly mobile species
  filter(!family %in% c("Carangidae", "Carcharhinidae", "Beloniformes")) %>%
  # Remove piscivores due to insufficient observations (n < 3 individuals total)
  filter(functional != "Piscivore")

# Load herbivory assay data and preprocess
assay <- read_data("herbivory_assay.csv") %>%
  # calculate amount consumed
  mutate(diff = Pre_algae_g - Post_algae_g) %>%
  # split Group column
  separate(col = Group, into = c("habitat", "environment"), sep = "(?<=Reef|Sand)") %>%
  # rename columns
  mutate(
    source    = as.factor(Source),
    cage      = as.factor(Place),
    date      = factor(Date,
                       levels = c("1/7/22", "2/7/22"),
                       labels = c("Day1", "Day2")),
    replicate = as.factor(Replicate)
  ) %>%
  # select desired
  dplyr::select(date, habitat, environment, replicate, source, cage, diff)

# Load site selection salinity & pH data
carb_chem <- read_data("water_chemistry.csv") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  # rename sampling times to day/night and high tide/low tide
  mutate(
    Environment  = str_replace(Environment, "SGD", "SGD Environment"),
    Environment  = str_replace(Environment, "Ambient", "Ambient Environment"),
    SamplingTime = str_replace(SamplingTime, "08:00", "Day Low Tide"),
    SamplingTime = str_replace(SamplingTime, "14:00", "Day High Tide"),
    SamplingTime = str_replace(SamplingTime, "20:00", "Night Low Tide"),
    SamplingTime = str_replace(SamplingTime, "02:00", "Night High Tide")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Replicate, Habitat, Environment, Tide, SamplingTime, TA, Salinity, pH) %>%
  mutate(
    # rename tidal states
    Tide = case_when(
      Tide == "Low"  ~ "Low Tide",
      Tide == "High" ~ "High Tide"
    ),
    # rename habitats
    Habitat = case_when(
      Habitat == "Reef" ~ "Reef Habitat",
      Habitat == "Sand" ~ "Sand Habitat"
    ),
    # turn columns into factors and relevel if necessary for plotting
    Environment = factor(Environment, levels = c("SGD Environment", "Ambient Environment")),

    # create facet group of habitat & SGD environment
    Facet_Group = paste(Habitat, Environment, sep = " "),
    # set order for group levels
    Facet_Group = factor(
      Facet_Group,
      levels = c(
        "Reef Habitat SGD Environment",
        "Sand Habitat SGD Environment",
        "Sand Habitat Ambient Environment",
        "Reef Habitat Ambient Environment"
      )
    )
  )

# Load Turbinaria ornata nutrient data
turbinaria <- read_data("turbinaria_nutrients.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert nitrogen measurements to percent content
    percent_N   = (ug_N / weight_mg) * 0.1,
    # Standardize SGD treatment labels
    Environment = str_replace(Environment, "SGD", "SGD Environment"),
    Environment = str_replace(Environment, "Ambient", "Ambient Environment")
  )

# Load Padina boryana nutrient data
padina <- read_data("padina_nutrients.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert nitrogen measurements to percent content
    percent_N   = (ug_N / weight_mg) * 0.1,
    # Standardize SGD treatment labels
    Environment = str_replace(Environment, "SGD", "SGD Environment"),
    Environment = str_replace(Environment, "Ambient", "Ambient Environment")
  )
```

```{r FigureStyle}
# check colorblind visibility

# ---- Figure theme (ggplot) ----
base_font <- 16

theme_meps <- function(base = base_font) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      axis.text        = element_text(size = rel(0.9), colour = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = rel(1)),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = rel(1), face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = rel(0.9)),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = rel(1.1), face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# Panel letters (A, B, C) in ggarrange
panel_label <- list(size = base_font + 4, face = "bold")

# ---- Table theme (supplementary tables, gridExtra) ----
table_theme <- ttheme_default(
  core = list(
    fg_params = list(fontsize = 10),
    bg_params = list(fill = c("white", "grey95"))
  ),
  colhead = list(
    fg_params = list(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    bg_params = list(fill = "grey85")
  )
)

# table helper
save_table <- function(grob, file, pad = 0.2) {
  w <- convertWidth(sum(grob$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
  h <- convertHeight(sum(grob$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
  png(here("Outputs", file), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid.draw(grob)
  dev.off()
}
```

## Plotting

### Fig. 1, Subplot A

```{r Fig1A}
# planar geometry
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Download French Polynesia outline
pyf    <- geodata::gadm("PYF", level = 0, path = here("Data")) %>% st_as_sf()
moorea <- st_crop(pyf,
                  xmin = -150.00, xmax = -149.70,
                  ymin = -17.65,  ymax = -17.42)

# General study location
study_site <- data.frame(lon = -149.90, lat = -17.54)

# ---- Scale bar ----
km_to_deg <- 1 / (111.32 * cos(17.53 * pi / 180))
sb_x0     <- -149.84
sb_y0     <- -17.615
sb_h      <- 0.003
breaks_km <- c(0, 1, 2, 4)

scale_bar <- data.frame(
  xmin = sb_x0 + head(breaks_km, -1) * km_to_deg,
  xmax = sb_x0 + breaks_km[-1] * km_to_deg,
  fill = rep(c("black", "white"), length.out = length(breaks_km) - 1)
)

# ---- North arrow ----
na_x     <- -149.755
na_y     <- -17.615
na_h     <- 0.017
na_w     <- 0.004
na_notch <- 0.004

north_arrow <- data.frame(
  x    = c(na_x, na_x - na_w, na_x,            na_x, na_x + na_w, na_x),
  y    = c(na_y + na_h, na_y, na_y + na_notch, na_y + na_h, na_y, na_y + na_notch),
  half = rep(c("left", "right"), each = 3)
)

label_size <- base_font * 0.55 / .pt

Fig1A <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = moorea, fill = "grey80", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = study_site, aes(lon, lat),
             shape = 21, size = 4, fill = "black", colour = "white", stroke = 1) +
  # Scale bar segments
  geom_rect(data = scale_bar,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = sb_y0, ymax = sb_y0 + sb_h, fill = fill),
            colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  annotate("text", x = sb_x0 + breaks_km * km_to_deg, y = sb_y0 + sb_h + 0.003,
           label = breaks_km, vjust = 0, size = label_size) +
  annotate("text", x = sb_x0 + max(breaks_km) * km_to_deg + 0.002, y = sb_y0 + sb_h / 2,
           label = "Km", hjust = 0, size = label_size) +
  # North arrow
  geom_polygon(data = north_arrow,
               aes(x, y, group = half, fill = I(ifelse(half == "left", "black", "white"))),
               colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = na_x, y = na_y + na_h + 0.003, label = "N",
           vjust = 0, size = label_size * 1.2) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-149.97, -149.73), ylim = c(-17.63, -17.45), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-149.9, -149.8, by = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-17.6, -17.5, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_meps() +
  theme(
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = rel(0.5))
  )

ggsave(here("Outputs", "Fig1A.png"), Fig1A, width = 4, height = 3.5, dpi = 600)
```

## Statistical Analyses

```{r Fig1Stats}
# ============================================================
# SALINITY ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

# ---- Grouping IDs ----
# Replicate (1-3) repeats across Environment x Habitat;
# Site = unique physical site (12), each sampled 4 times
# (high/low tide x day/night)
carb_chem <- carb_chem %>%
  mutate(Site = interaction(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, drop = TRUE))

# ---- Random-effects structure selection ----
salinity_site <- glmmTMB(
  Salinity ~ Environment * Tide + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  data = carb_chem
)
check_singularity(salinity_site)
VarCorr(salinity_site)   # habitat SD ~ 0 (0.0003); site SD ~ 2.6 -> drop habitat, keep site

# ---- Model 1: Gamma GLMM ----
salinity_model <- glmmTMB(
  Salinity ~ Environment * Tide + (1|Site),
  data   = carb_chem,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)
sim1 <- simulateResiduals(salinity_model, n = 1000)

check_singularity(salinity_model)   # OK
testUniformity(sim1)$p.value        # fail
testDispersion(sim1)$p.value        # fail
testOutliers(sim1)$p.value          # fail

# ---- Model 2: Gaussian, same structure ----
salinity_gauss <- glmmTMB(
  Salinity ~ Environment * Tide + (1|Site),
  data = carb_chem
)
sim2 <- simulateResiduals(salinity_gauss, n = 1000)
plot(sim2)

check_singularity(salinity_gauss)   # OK
testDispersion(sim2)$p.value        # OK
testUniformity(sim2)$p.value        # fail
testOutliers(sim2)$p.value          # fail
testCategorical(sim2, catPred = interaction(carb_chem$Environment, carb_chem$Tide)) 
# Note: uniformity + outlier flags trace to a few genuine low-salinity readings at the seep.
# Dispersion is satisfied and AIC favors Gaussian.

# ---- Model comparison ----
AIC(salinity_model, salinity_gauss)   # Gaussian favored

# ---- Tidal contrasts within each environment (two-sided) ----
salinity_contrasts <- emmeans(salinity_gauss, ~ Tide | Environment) %>%
  pairs(adjust = "Tukey")

# Estimated marginal mean salinity (PSU) by tide within each environment
salinity_emm <- emmeans(salinity_gauss, ~ Tide | Environment)

salinity_pct <- as.data.frame(salinity_emm) %>%
  dplyr::select(Environment, Tide, emmean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tide, values_from = emmean) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_reduction_PSU = `High Tide` - `Low Tide`,
    pct_reduction     = abs_reduction_PSU / `High Tide` * 100
  )

# ============================================================
# ALGAL NITROGEN CONTENT ANALYSIS
# ============================================================
turbinaria_mixed <- glmer(
  percent_N ~ Environment + (1|Habitat),
  data   = turbinaria,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

# Random effect variance = 0, simplify to fixed effects model
turbinaria_model <- glm(
  percent_N ~ Environment,
  data   = turbinaria,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

# ---- Assumption checks (DHARMa) ----
sim_turb <- simulateResiduals(turbinaria_model, n = 1000)
testUniformity(sim_turb)$p.value                          # OK
testDispersion(sim_turb)$p.value                          # OK
testOutliers(sim_turb)$p.value                            # OK
plotResiduals(sim_turb, form = turbinaria$Environment)    # OK

# ---- Environment contrast (two-sided) ----
nitrogen_contrast <- emmeans(turbinaria_model, ~ Environment) %>%
  pairs()   # single comparison, no multiplicity adjustment
```

## Supplemental Materials

### Table S1

```{r S1Table}
# Get two-sided contrasts with CIs and p-values
salinity_contrasts_twosided <- emmeans(salinity_gauss, ~ Tide | Environment) %>%
  pairs(adjust = "tukey") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE)

salinity_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(salinity_contrasts_twosided)

table_S1 <- salinity_contrasts_df %>%
  mutate(
    diff_formatted = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
    CI_formatted   = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", lower.CL, upper.CL),
    SE_formatted   = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
    t_formatted    = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio),
    df_formatted   = sprintf("%.0f", df),
    p_formatted    = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Environment, contrast, diff_formatted, CI_formatted,
                t_formatted, df_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Environment"                  = Environment,
    "Contrast"                     = contrast,
    "Difference (High − Low, PSU)" = diff_formatted,
    "95% CI"                       = CI_formatted,
    "t"                            = t_formatted,
    "df"                           = df_formatted,
    "p"                            = p_formatted
  )

table_S1_grob <- tableGrob(table_S1, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S1_grob, "TableS1.png")
```

### Table S2

```{r S2Table}
nitrogen_contrast <- emmeans(turbinaria_model, ~ Environment) %>%
  pairs() %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE)

# Build table
nitrogen_df <- summary(nitrogen_contrast, infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()

table_S2 <- nitrogen_df %>%
  mutate(
    contrast        = "SGD / Ambient",
    ratio           = exp(-estimate),
    ratio_lower     = exp(-upper.CL),
    ratio_upper     = exp(-lower.CL),
    ratio_formatted = sprintf("%.3f", ratio),
    CI_formatted    = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ratio_lower, ratio_upper),
    SE_formatted    = sprintf("%.3f", SE),
    t_formatted     = sprintf("%.2f", -t.ratio),   # flip sign because the ratio was inverted
    df_formatted    = sprintf("%.0f", df),
    p_formatted     = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(contrast, ratio_formatted, CI_formatted,
                t_formatted, df_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Contrast"        = contrast,
    "Ratio (SGD/Amb)" = ratio_formatted,
    "95% CI"          = CI_formatted,
    "t"               = t_formatted,
    "df"              = df_formatted,
    "p"               = p_formatted
  )

table_S2_grob <- tableGrob(table_S2, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S2_grob, "TableS2.png")
```

# Figure 2.

## Plotting

### Fig. 2 sizing

```{r Fig2Style}
fig2_base  <- 10                                          # text size (pt) at print size
fig2_label <- list(size = fig2_base + 2, face = "bold")   # panel letters
fig2_text  <- fig2_base * 0.9 / .pt                       # geom_text size matching axis text
```

### Fig. 2 data processing

```{r Fig2process}
# Summarize functional group abundances for each replicate sample
funcs <- all_cam %>%
  # Filter for natural activity (i.e. non-feeding) observations only
  filter(Activity == "nat") %>%

  # Group by habitat, environment (SGD exposures), tidal state, replicate, functional group, and unique species code
  group_by(Habitat, Environment, Tide, Replicate, functional, code) %>%

  # For each unique combination, retain the first observed maximum abundance (nmax)
  summarise(nmax = first(nmax)) %>%

  # Collapse across codes to get total abundance for each functional group in each sample
  group_by(Habitat, Environment, Tide, Replicate, functional) %>%
  summarize(total = sum(nmax)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # Ensure all combinations are included, filling missing totals with 0
  complete(Habitat, Environment, Tide, Replicate, functional, fill = list(total = 0)) %>%

  # Drop rows with any missing values (for example, incomplete replicates)
  drop_na() %>%

  # Order functional groups for consistent plotting and analysis
  mutate(
    functional = factor(
      functional,
      levels  = c("Omnivore", "Herbivore", "Invertivore", "Corallivore"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```


### Fig. 2, Subplot B

```{r Fig2Bprocess}
# Calculate mean relative abundance for each genus in SGD and Ambient environments
relative_abundance_data <- all_cam %>%
  filter(Activity == "nat") %>%                                                  # Only swimming fish activity, not feeding observations
  complete(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, genus, fill = list(nmax = 0)) %>%    # Ensure all genus x site x replicate combos are present, fill zeros
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate) %>%
  mutate(total_abundance = sum(nmax, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%                          # Total fish abundance per replicate
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, genus) %>%
  summarise(
    species_abundance = sum(nmax, na.rm = TRUE),                                 # Total abundance for each genus per replicate
    total_abundance   = first(total_abundance),                                  # Carry forward replicate total
    rel_abundance     = ifelse(total_abundance > 0, species_abundance / total_abundance, 0),  # Proportion of community
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Identify genera found only in SGD and not in Ambient
sgd_species <- relative_abundance_data %>%
  filter(Environment == "SGD", rel_abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(genus) %>%
  pull(genus)

ambient_species <- relative_abundance_data %>%
  filter(Environment == "Ambient", rel_abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(genus) %>%
  pull(genus)

# List of genera unique to SGD
sgd_unique_species <- setdiff(sgd_species, ambient_species)

# Get mean relative abundance for every genus in SGD environments
sgd_all_data <- relative_abundance_data %>%
  filter(Environment == "SGD") %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rel_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),   # Average prop. across all SGD replicates
    .groups            = "drop"
  )

# Add functional group annotation and unique/non-unique status
species_functional_map <- all_cam %>%
  dplyr::select(genus, functional) %>%
  distinct()

sgd_all_data <- sgd_all_data %>%
  left_join(species_functional_map, by = "genus") %>%                  # Annotate by functional group
  mutate(
    genus      = str_trim(genus),                                      # Remove trailing/leading spaces
    functional = str_trim(functional),
    functional = str_to_title(functional),                             # Standardize capitalization
    functional = ifelse(is.na(functional), "Unknown", functional),     # Assign "Unknown" if missing
    is_unique  = genus %in% sgd_unique_species,
    # Assign display category for plotting: highlight unique functional group, grey others
    display_functional = ifelse(is_unique, functional, "Non-unique"),
    # Remove very low-N unique herbivores and invertivores
    display_functional = ifelse(functional == "Herbivore", "Non-unique", display_functional),
    display_functional = ifelse(functional == "Invertivore", "Non-unique", display_functional),
    # For stacked bar: set order so unique omnivores appear first
    display_functional_order = case_when(
      display_functional == "Omnivore"   ~ 1,
      display_functional == "Non-unique" ~ 2,
      TRUE                               ~ 3
    )
  )

# Prep for stacked bar chart (cumulative proportions)
sgd_all_data <- sgd_all_data %>%
  arrange(display_functional_order, desc(mean_rel_abundance)) %>%   # Show unique omnivores first
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    proportion     = mean_rel_abundance,                  # For clarity
    cum_proportion = cumsum(proportion),                  # Cumulative sum for stacking
    start_pos      = lag(cum_proportion, default = 0),    # Stacking start position
    end_pos        = cum_proportion                       # Stacking end position
  )

# Label color: white on dark green, black on light grey
sgd_all_data <- sgd_all_data %>%
  mutate(label_col = if_else(display_functional == "Omnivore", "white", "black")) %>%
  mutate(
    label_col  = if_else(display_functional == "Omnivore", "white", "black"),
    short_name = sub("^(\\S)\\S*\\s+", "\\1. ", genus)   # "Kuhlia mugil" -> "K. mugil"
  )

functional_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = sgd_color,   # unique SGD omnivores
  "Non-unique" = "#D3D3D3"    # species also found in ambient
)

Fig2B <- ggplot(sgd_all_data, aes(xmin = start_pos, xmax = end_pos, ymin = 0, ymax = 1)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill = display_functional), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # genus names (bars > 5%)
  geom_text(data = filter(sgd_all_data, proportion > 0.05),
            aes(x = (start_pos + end_pos) / 2, y = 0.5, label = short_name, colour = label_col),
            fontface = "bold.italic", size = (fig2_base + 1) / .pt, angle = 90) +
  # % below the unique omnivores
  geom_text(data = filter(sgd_all_data, proportion > 0.05, display_functional == "Omnivore"),
            aes(x = (start_pos + end_pos) / 2, y = -0.1,
                label = paste0(round(proportion * 100, 1), "%")),
            colour = sgd_color, fontface = "bold", size = fig2_base / .pt) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = functional_colors,
                    breaks = c("Omnivore", "Non-unique"),
                    labels = c("Unique SGD species (omnivores)", "Remaining species")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-0.25, 1.1)) +
  labs(x = "Mean relative abundance") +
  theme_meps(base = fig2_base) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    panel.border    = element_blank(),
    axis.text       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = fig2_base),
    legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm")
  )
```

### Fig. 2, Subplot C data processing

```{r Fig2C}
# Calculate observed species richness per replicate
genus_diversity_indices <- all_cam %>%
  # Filter for all fish observations (non feeding only)
  filter(Activity == "nat") %>%

  # Group by habitat, SGD exposure, tidal state, replicate, and unique species code
  group_by(Habitat, Environment, Tide, Replicate, code) %>%

  # Retain first maximum abundance value for each species in each replicate
  summarise(nmax = first(nmax)) %>%

  # Summarize by site
  group_by(Habitat, Environment, Tide, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    richness = n_distinct(code),   # Count unique species (codes) for richness
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Combine SGD and tide as a single factor for downstream use
  mutate(sgd_tide = paste(Environment, Tide))
```

## Statistical Analyses

```{r Fig2Astats}
# ============================================================
# Figure 2A: Functional group abundance across SGD environments
# Negative binomial GLMM (glmmTMB), two-tailed post-hoc contrasts
# ============================================================

# ---- Grouping IDs ----
# Replicate (1-3) = hourly filming rotation; repeats across Environment x Habitat
#   Site  = unique physical site (12); each site surveyed once per tide

funcs <- funcs %>%
  mutate(
    Site  = interaction(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, drop = TRUE),
    Block = interaction(Tide, Replicate, drop = TRUE)
  )

# ---- Random-effects structure selection ----
# Model 1: habitat only
mixed_model1 <- glmmTMB(
  total ~ Environment * Tide * functional + (1|Habitat),
  family = nbinom2, data = funcs
)

# Model 2: habitat + site (repeated surveys of the same site)
mixed_model2 <- glmmTMB(
  total ~ Environment * Tide * functional + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  family = nbinom2, data = funcs
)

AIC(mixed_model1, mixed_model2)
VarCorr(mixed_model2)   # site SD ~ 0.27: non-zero, non-singular -> retained
check_singularity(mixed_model2)

# Final model: site retained as the design-based repeated-measures unit
abundance_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(
  total ~ Environment * Tide * functional + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  family = nbinom2,
  data   = funcs
)

# ============================================================
# Model assumption checks
# ============================================================
abundance_sim <- simulateResiduals(abundance_mixed_model)

check_singularity(abundance_mixed_model)
testUniformity(abundance_sim)$p.value
testDispersion(abundance_sim)$p.value
testOutliers(abundance_sim)$p.value

# ============================================================
# Post-hoc contrasts
# ============================================================

# ---- (1) SGD vs Ambient, averaged over tide, within each functional group ----
emm_sgd <- emmeans(abundance_mixed_model, ~ Environment * functional)
all_sgd_contrasts <- emm_sgd %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", type = "response", by = "functional") %>%
  summary(adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ---- (2) High vs Low tide, within each Environment x functional group ----
emm_tide <- emmeans(abundance_mixed_model, ~ Tide | Environment + functional)
all_tide_contrasts <- emm_tide %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", type = "response") %>%
  summary(adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(functional, Environment)

# ---- (3) SGD vs Ambient, separately at each tidal state ----
emm_sgd_by_tide <- emmeans(abundance_mixed_model, ~ Environment | Tide + functional)
sgd_by_tide_all <- emm_sgd_by_tide %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", type = "response") %>%
  summary(adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(functional, Tide)

all_sgd_contrasts <- emm_sgd %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", type = "response", by = "functional") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE, adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame()

sgd_by_tide_all <- emm_sgd_by_tide %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", type = "response") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE, adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Ambient/SGD from emmeans -> flip to SGD/Ambient
flip <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    transmute(
      across(any_of(c("functional", "Tide"))),
      ratio_SGD = 1 / ratio,
      LCL       = 1 / asymp.UCL,
      UCL       = 1 / asymp.LCL,
      z         = -z.ratio,
      p         = p.value
    )
}
```

```{r fig2Cstats}
# Unique site ID
genus_diversity_indices <- genus_diversity_indices %>%
  mutate(Site = interaction(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, drop = TRUE))

# Species richness: habitat + site random intercepts
richness_model <- glmmTMB(
  richness ~ Environment * Tide + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  family = nbinom2,
  data   = genus_diversity_indices
)

# ============================================================
# Model assumption checks (re-run: model changed)
# ============================================================
richness_sim <- simulateResiduals(richness_model)
check_singularity(richness_model)
testUniformity(richness_sim)$p.value
testDispersion(richness_sim)$p.value
testOutliers(richness_sim)$p.value
VarCorr(richness_model)

# Tidal contrasts within each environment
emm_richness <- emmeans(richness_model, ~ Tide | Environment, type = "response")
richness_contrasts <- emm_richness %>%
  contrast(method = "pairwise", adjust = "tukey") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
richness_contrasts
```

## Supplemental Materials

### Table S3

```{r TableS3}
emm_sgd <- emmeans(abundance_mixed_model, ~ Environment * functional)
sgd_df <- contrast(emm_sgd, method = "pairwise", type = "response",
                   by = "functional") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE, adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame()

table_S3 <- sgd_df %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_sgd       = 1 / ratio,                    # emmeans gives Ambient/SGD -> invert
    CI_lower        = 1 / asymp.UCL,
    CI_upper        = 1 / asymp.LCL,
    ratio_formatted = sprintf("%.2f", ratio_sgd),
    CI_formatted    = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    z_formatted     = sprintf("%.2f", -z.ratio),    # flip sign because the ratio was inverted
    p_formatted     = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(functional, ratio_formatted, CI_formatted, z_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Trophic Group"   = functional,
    "Ratio (SGD/Amb)" = ratio_formatted,
    "95% CI"          = CI_formatted,
    "z"               = z_formatted,
    "p"               = p_formatted
  )

table_S3_grob <- tableGrob(table_S3, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S3_grob, "TableS3.png")
```

# Figure 3.

## Plotting Start

```{r Fig3plot_1}
# Functional group bite rate analysis
# Identify which species were present at each replicate-tide
present_species <- all_cam %>%
  filter(Activity == "nat") %>%
  distinct(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, Tide) %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE)

# Calculate bite rates for each species at each substrate
species_bite_rates_substrate <- all_cam %>%
  filter(Activity == "feed") %>%
  dplyr::select(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, substrate, Tide, nmax, Number_bites) %>%

  # Summarize by species-substrate-tide
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, substrate, Tide) %>%
  summarize(
    n_ind       = max(nmax),
    total_bites = sum(Number_bites),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

# Expand present species to both substrates since if a species was present, it could feed at either substrate
present_species_both_substrates <- present_species %>%
  dplyr::select(-present) %>%
  expand_grid(substrate = c("Benthos", "Water Column"))

# Join feeding data with presence data
# This keeps all present species-substrate combos, filling zeros where no feeding observed
species_bite_rates_complete <- present_species_both_substrates %>%
  left_join(species_bite_rates_substrate,
            by = c("Environment", "Habitat", "Replicate", "code", "functional", "substrate", "Tide")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_ind       = replace_na(n_ind, 0),
    total_bites = replace_na(total_bites, 0),
    bite_rate   = if_else(n_ind > 0, (total_bites / n_ind) / 10, 0)
  )

# Aggregate to functional groups by substrate
functional_bite_rates_substrate <- species_bite_rates_complete %>%
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, functional, substrate, Tide) %>%
  summarize(
    n_ind       = sum(n_ind),
    total_bites = sum(total_bites),
    bite_rate   = if_else(n_ind > 0, (total_bites / n_ind) / 10, 0),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

# Calculate tidal differences
func_groups <- functional_bite_rates_substrate %>%
  # Reshape: one row per site-functional-substrate, columns for each tide
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, functional, substrate),
    names_from  = Tide,
    values_from = bite_rate
  ) %>%
  # Calculate difference (Low - High)
  mutate(diff = `Low Tide` - `High Tide`) %>%
  # Remove cases where functional group wasn't present at both tides
  drop_na(diff) %>%
  # Unique site ID (Replicate = filming block, repeats across Environment x Habitat)
  mutate(Site = interaction(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, drop = TRUE))

stopifnot(n_distinct(func_groups$Site) == 12)

# Raw group means
func_means <- func_groups %>%
  # Summarize bite rate differences by environment, functional group, and substrate
  group_by(Environment, functional, substrate) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bite_rate = mean(diff),                 # Mean bite rate difference (Low - High tide)
    sd_bite_rate   = sd(diff),                   # Standard deviation
    se_bite_rate   = sd_bite_rate / sqrt(n()),   # Standard error
    .groups        = "drop"
  ) %>%
  drop_na()                                      # Remove any incomplete group summaries
```

## Statistical Analyses

```{r Fig3stats}
# ============================================================
# Gaussian GLMM: diff = low-minus-high tide bite rate
# ============================================================
fig3_m2 <- glmmTMB(
  diff ~ Environment * substrate * functional + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  dispformula = ~ Environment, family = gaussian, data = func_groups
)

VarCorr(fig3_m2)             # Habitat SD ~ 0
check_singularity(fig3_m2)   # CHECK: TRUE

# Final model: site only
my_glmm_gaussian <- glmmTMB(
  diff ~ Environment * substrate * functional + (1|Site),
  dispformula = ~ Environment, family = gaussian, data = func_groups
)

# ============================================================
# Model assumption checks (re-run: model changed)
# ============================================================
gauss_sim <- simulateResiduals(my_glmm_gaussian)
check_singularity(my_glmm_gaussian)
testUniformity(gauss_sim)
testDispersion(gauss_sim)
testOutliers(gauss_sim)

VarCorr(my_glmm_gaussian)

# ============================================================
# Test whether tidal difference != 0
# ============================================================
feeding_emm <- emmeans(my_glmm_gaussian,
                       ~ Environment * substrate * functional)

feeding_tests <- test(feeding_emm, null = 0, adjust = "fdr") %>%
  as.data.frame()
feeding_tests
```

## Plotting End

```{r Fig3plot_2}
# Flag significant cells from the GLMM tests
sig_results <- feeding_tests %>%
  mutate(is_sig = p.value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Environment, substrate, functional, is_sig, p.value)

# Attach significance to a data frame and define fill
add_sig <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(sig_results, by = c("Environment", "substrate", "functional")) %>%
    mutate(fill_key = ifelse(is_sig, as.character(Environment), "ns"))
}

func_means_model <- summary(feeding_emm) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    Environment    = as.character(Environment),
    substrate      = as.character(substrate),
    functional     = as.character(functional),
    mean_bite_rate = emmean,
    se_bite_rate   = SE
  )

func_groups_sig <- add_sig(func_groups)        # site-level differences
func_means_sig  <- add_sig(func_means_model)   # model estimates ± SE

# Numeric y positions (replaces position_dodge so raw points can be jittered vertically)
y_levels  <- sort(unique(as.character(func_means_sig$functional)))   # same order as before
dodge_off <- c(Ambient = -0.15, SGD = 0.15)                           # Ambient below, SGD above

place_y <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(y = match(as.character(functional), y_levels) +
                 dodge_off[as.character(Environment)])
}

set.seed(123)                                     # reproducible jitter
func_groups_plot <- place_y(func_groups_sig) %>%
  mutate(y = y + runif(n(), -0.08, 0.08))         # vertical jitter only; x (diff) unchanged
func_means_plot  <- place_y(func_means_sig)

# ---- y positions ----
y_levels  <- sort(unique(as.character(func_means_sig$functional)))   # same order as before
dodge_off <- c(Ambient = -0.15, SGD = 0.15)   # model means: Ambient below, SGD above
peek      <- 0.09                             # raw points: offset from their mean (y units)

place_y <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(y = match(as.character(functional), y_levels) +
                 dodge_off[as.character(Environment)])
}

func_means_plot  <- place_y(func_means_sig)
func_groups_plot <- place_y(func_groups_sig) %>%
  # nudge outward (Ambient down, SGD up) so points peek out from behind the means
  mutate(y = y + sign(dodge_off[as.character(Environment)]) * peek)

Fig3 <- ggplot(func_means_plot, aes(x = mean_bite_rate, y = y)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  # site-level differences
  geom_point(data = func_groups_plot,
             aes(x = diff, y = y, colour = Environment),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # model SE bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin   = mean_bite_rate - se_bite_rate,
                    xmax   = mean_bite_rate + se_bite_rate,
                    colour = Environment),
                width = 0.1, orientation = "y", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # model means: filled = significant, solid white = n.s.
  geom_point(aes(colour = Environment, fill = fill_key),
             shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ substrate) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Ambient" = ambient_color,
                                 "SGD"     = sgd_color)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ambient" = ambient_color,
                               "SGD"     = sgd_color,
                               "ns"      = "white"),
                    guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = c(ambient_color, sgd_color)))) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number_auto(),
    limits = function(x) c(-max(abs(x)), max(abs(x)))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(y_levels), labels = y_levels,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_meps() +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title         = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y   = element_blank()
  )
```

## Supplemental Materials

### Table S6

```{r TableS6}
# Identify which species were present at each site-tide
present_species <- all_cam %>%
  filter(Activity == "nat") %>%
  distinct(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, Tide) %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE)

# Calculate bite rates for each species
species_bite_rates <- all_cam %>%
  filter(Activity == "feed") %>%
  dplyr::select(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, Tide, nmax, Number_bites) %>%
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, code, functional, Tide) %>%
  summarize(
    n_ind       = max(nmax),
    total_bites = sum(Number_bites),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Join with presence - keeps only species that were present
  right_join(present_species, by = c("Environment", "Habitat", "Replicate", "code", "functional", "Tide")) %>%
  # Fill zeros for species present but not feeding
  mutate(
    n_ind       = replace_na(n_ind, 0),
    total_bites = replace_na(total_bites, 0),
    bite_rate   = if_else(n_ind > 0, (total_bites / n_ind) / 10, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-present)

# Aggregate to functional groups
feed <- species_bite_rates %>%
  group_by(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, functional, Tide) %>%
  summarize(
    n_ind       = sum(n_ind),
    total_bites = sum(total_bites),
    bite_rate   = if_else(n_ind > 0, (total_bites / n_ind) / 10, 0),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Unique site ID (Replicate = filming block, repeats across Environment x Habitat)
  mutate(Site = interaction(Environment, Habitat, Replicate, drop = TRUE))

# ============================================================
# Tweedie GLMM: per-capita bite rate
# ============================================================
feed_model <- glmmTMB(
  bite_rate ~ Environment * functional * Tide + (1|Habitat) + (1|Site),
  family = glmmTMB::tweedie(link = "log"),
  data   = feed
)

# ============================================================
# Model assumption checks
# ============================================================
feed_sim <- simulateResiduals(feed_model)
plot(feed_sim)                   # OK
testDispersion(feed_sim)         # OK (p = 0.65)
testZeroInflation(feed_sim)      # OK (p = 0.64)
testUniformity(feed_sim)         # OK (p = 0.95)
check_singularity(feed_model)    # FALSE

# ============================================================
# Per-tide SGD vs Ambient contrasts
# ============================================================
sgd_emmeans_feed <- emmeans(feed_model, ~ Environment | Tide + functional,
                            type = "response")
sgd_contrasts_feed <- pairs(sgd_emmeans_feed) %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE, adjust = "tukey")
feed_df <- as.data.frame(sgd_contrasts_feed)

table_S6 <- feed_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group           = paste(functional, Tide, sep = " - "),
    ratio_sgd       = 1 / ratio,                    # emmeans gives Ambient/SGD -> invert
    CI_lower        = 1 / asymp.UCL,
    CI_upper        = 1 / asymp.LCL,
    ratio_formatted = sprintf("%.2f", ratio_sgd),
    CI_formatted    = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    z_formatted     = sprintf("%.2f", -z.ratio),    # flip sign because the ratio was inverted
    p_formatted     = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, ratio_formatted, CI_formatted, z_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Trophic Group - Tide" = Group,
    "Ratio (SGD/Amb)"      = ratio_formatted,
    "95% CI"               = CI_formatted,
    "z"                    = z_formatted,
    "p"                    = p_formatted
  )

table_S6_grob <- tableGrob(table_S6, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S6_grob, "TableS6.png")
```

# Figure 4.

## Data processing

```{r Fig4A_data}
# Consumption = open-assay loss minus caged-control loss
herb_assay <- assay %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cage", values_from = "diff") %>%
  mutate(
    consumed = open - cage,
    consumed = pmax(0, consumed)   # water weight gain set to 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-cage, -open)
```

```{r Fig4Stats}
# Test Delta 15N differences between SGD and ambient environments

p_delN_gamma_model <- glm(del15N ~ Environment, data = padina, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
```

```{r Fig4A_model}
Fig4A <- ggplot(herb_assay, aes(x = source, colour = environment)) +
  # raw assays
  geom_point(aes(y = consumed), alpha = 0.35, size = 2,

                                             dodge.width = 0.4, seed = 123)) +

  geom_errorbar(data = emm_4A, aes(ymin = pmax(response - SE, 0), ymax = response + SE),
                position = dodge, width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +

  geom_point(data = emm_4A, aes(y = response), position = dodge, size = 2.6) +
```

### Table S8

```{r TableS8}
# Extract coefficients table from model summary
herbivory_summary <- summary(tweedie_model)
model_coeffs      <- herbivory_summary$coefficients$cond

model_coeffs_df <- data.frame(
  Term      = rownames(model_coeffs),
  Estimate  = model_coeffs[, 1],
  SE        = model_coeffs[, 2],
  z_value   = model_coeffs[, 3],
  p_value   = model_coeffs[, 4],
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_upper = Estimate + 1.96 * SE
  )

table_S8 <- model_coeffs_df %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_formatted = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
    CI_formatted       = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    z_formatted        = sprintf("%.2f", z_value),
    p_formatted        = case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                   TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Term, Estimate_formatted, CI_formatted, z_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Model Term"     = Term,
    "Estimate (log)" = Estimate_formatted,
    "95% CI"         = CI_formatted,
    "z"              = z_formatted,
    "p"              = p_formatted
  )

table_S8_grob <- tableGrob(table_S8, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S8_grob, "TableS8.png")
```

### Table S10

```{r TableS10}
del_contrast <- emmeans(p_delN_gamma_model, ~ Environment, type = "response") %>%
  pairs() %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE)   # two-sided, CIs + p in one call

percentN_contrast <- emmeans(p_percentN_gamma_model, ~ Environment, type = "response") %>%
  pairs() %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE)

del_df  <- as.data.frame(del_contrast)      %>% mutate(Parameter = "δ15N (‰)")
pctN_df <- as.data.frame(percentN_contrast) %>% mutate(Parameter = "Nitrogen (%)")

del_resid_df  <- df.residual(p_delN_gamma_model)
pctN_resid_df <- df.residual(p_percentN_gamma_model)

table_S10 <- bind_rows(del_df, pctN_df) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_sgd        = 1 / ratio,                   # invert to SGD/Ambient
    CI_lower         = 1 / upper.CL,
    CI_upper         = 1 / lower.CL,
    percent_increase = sprintf("%.0f%%", (ratio_sgd - 1) * 100),
    ratio_formatted  = sprintf("%.3f", ratio_sgd),
    CI_formatted     = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    t_formatted      = sprintf("%.2f", -t.ratio),   # flip sign because the ratio was inverted
    df_formatted     = sprintf("%.0f", ifelse(Parameter == "δ15N (‰)", del_resid_df, pctN_resid_df)),
    p_formatted      = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                 TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Parameter, ratio_formatted, CI_formatted, percent_increase,
         t_formatted, df_formatted, p_formatted) %>%
  rename(
    "Parameter"       = Parameter,
    "Ratio (SGD/Amb)" = ratio_formatted,
    "95% CI"          = CI_formatted,
    "SGD Increase"    = percent_increase,
    "t"               = t_formatted,
    "df"              = df_formatted,
    "p"               = p_formatted
  )

table_S10_grob <- tableGrob(table_S10, theme = table_theme, rows = NULL)
save_table(table_S10_grob, "TableS10.png")
```
